currentParagraphText: “You’re done?” Jake asked. By the time he’d opened his eyes, the vampire goddess was already sitting upright, now fully covered in a dress that didn’t show any skin besides her face and hands.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I’m done,” the Sword Saint nodded. The vampire got up and went around the easel to see the finished painting. When she saw it, she smiled and nodded.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Taking advantage of that move, Jake moved his hand up to block the drop with a finger right before he opened his eyes. Being woken up by an incoming “attack” was way less suspicious than just waking up by himself.
